question: 宁德时代2025年成交量最高的交易日的收盘价是多少元？
gold_sql: SELECT close AS answer FROM daily_quotes q JOIN companies c ON c.code=q.code WHERE c.short_name='宁德时代' ORDER BY volume_hand DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年全年区间涨跌幅（2025-12-31收盘/2025-01-02收盘-1，小数）最高的公司简称是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT c.short_name AS answer FROM companies c JOIN daily_quotes qs ON qs.code=c.code AND qs.trade_date='2025-12-31' JOIN daily_quotes qe ON qe.code=c.code AND qe.trade_date='2025-01-02' ORDER BY qs.close/qe.close-1.0 DESC LIMIT 1

question: 五粮液2025年下半年成交量最高的交易日是哪一天？（返回YYYY-MM-DD）
gold_sql: SELECT q.trade_date AS answer FROM daily_quotes q JOIN companies c ON c.code=q.code WHERE c.short_name='五粮液' AND q.trade_date>='2025-07-01' AND q.trade_date<='2025-12-31' ORDER BY q.volume_hand DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年年报商誉总额（所有公司合计）是多少亿元？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(goodwill)/100000000.0 AS answer FROM balance_sheets WHERE report_date='2025-12-31'

question: 28家公司中，最新总市值超过3000亿元的有几家？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer FROM market_snapshot WHERE total_mv_yuan>300000000000.0

question: 按行业（sector）统计最新总市值合计，总市值最高的行业是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT c.sector AS answer FROM market_snapshot s JOIN companies c ON c.code=s.code GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY SUM(s.total_mv_yuan) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年年报净现比（经营现金流净额/归母净利润）大于1且归母净利润为正的公司数量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer FROM income_statements i JOIN cashflow_statements cf ON cf.code=i.code AND cf.report_date=i.report_date WHERE i.report_date='2025-12-31' AND i.parent_net_profit>0 AND cf.op_cashflow/i.parent_net_profit>1

question: 2026年半年报营业总收入最高的行业（按行业内公司营收合计）是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT c.sector AS answer FROM income_statements i JOIN companies c ON c.code=i.code WHERE i.report_date='2026-06-30' GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY SUM(i.total_revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年年报商誉占归母净资产比例最高的公司简称是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT c.short_name AS answer FROM balance_sheets b JOIN companies c ON c.code=b.code WHERE b.report_date='2025-12-31' AND b.total_parent_equity>0 AND b.goodwill IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.goodwill/b.total_parent_equity DESC LIMIT 1

question: 所有公司2026年半年报经营活动现金流量净额合计是多少亿元？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(op_cashflow)/100000000.0 AS answer FROM cashflow_statements WHERE report_date='2026-06-30'

question: 2025年年报基本每股收益最高的公司简称是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT c.short_name AS answer FROM income_statements i JOIN companies c ON c.code=i.code WHERE i.report_date='2025-12-31' AND i.basic_eps IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.basic_eps DESC LIMIT 1
